purpose: Four sprites applied to the DigDeep equipment branches

assets.name: Drill
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated transparent gameplay equipment sprite for DigDeep, a portrait 2D pixel mining game with five columns. It must be easily readable at 64x64 pixels inside ONE tile. Coarse crisp square pixel art as if designed on a 24x24 or 32x32 logical grid, large pixel clusters, limited palette, dark stepped outline, two or three flat shades per material, very little detail. Flat front view, no perspective depth, no photorealism, no fine texture, no smooth gradients or glossy rendered surface. Center the whole object with comfortable even transparent margin. One tool only; no person, hands, arms, character, terrain, floor, vehicle, scene, UI, text, letters, numbers, logo, label, extra icon, motion blur, glow, shadow or checkerboard drawn into the background. Genuinely transparent alpha outside the object. Subject: compact handheld powered mining DRILL designed for a straight UP-AND-DOWN reciprocating mining animation. The whole tool is absolutely VERTICAL and untilted, with its sharp drilling bit pointing straight DOWN on the center axis. A small horizontal black T-bar grip at the TOP, a slim ochre-yellow rectangular motor casing immediately below, a visibly narrow short central steel shaft, then a tapered steel-gray drill bit with just three or four broad helical stepped flutes at the BOTTOM. Overall width about half the total height, slim and lightweight, not bulky. The grip, body, exposed shaft and drill tip all share one vertical centerline. A small visible gap around the shaft makes the bit clear for later animation. A single neutral resting pose, no duplicate frames, no rotation or diagonal pose. Keep the clear gray screw-shaped pointed tip long enough to read at small size, with a dark body outline and one simple vent on the yellow casing.

assets.name: TungstenPick
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE simple TUNGSTEN PICKAXE sprite for a coarse pixel-art 2D mining game. Draw an upright FRONT VIEW pickaxe as a flat low-resolution icon made from LARGE clean SQUARE PIXELS. Visual design about 19 pixels wide and 18 pixels tall before enlargement. Width and height approximately equal. A shallow symmetric arched metal head across the TOP and a short straight brown handle centered below, both tips curving down by stepped square pixels. Head silhouette perfectly mirror-symmetric left-to-right. The head is COOL BLUE-GRAY with a few SILVER edge blocks and CHARCOAL underside, only three flat shades. Head spans about 17 large pixels; center thickness about 3 pixels; tips 2 pixels thick. A brown handle only 3 pixels wide, with a tiny brass collar immediately under the head and TWO simple dark-gray reinforcing bands on the lower handle. The handle extends downward about 10 large pixels, keeping the pick compact, not long-handled. An opaque, hard CHARCOAL stepped pixel outline defines every outer edge. One whole tool centered with empty even margins. Only a handful of flat colors; NO gradient, NO lighting effects, NO bloom, NO fuzzy halo, NO glow, NO shadow, NO atmosphere, NO feathered edge, NO translucent metal or wood, NO smooth texture, NO perspective, NO 3D shading, NO text or letters, NO background scene. Outside the exact solid pixel silhouette, everything is genuinely and completely TRANSPARENT alpha. Blank space between the handle and the curved head must also be fully transparent. This is a clean functional sprite cutout, not a presentation illustration.
